title: SnowOps Labs Incident (fault.yaml)
description: Schema for a SnowOps Labs incident/fault definition. The detection check passes if and only if the fault is RESOLVED.

name.description: Must match the incident directory name.

verified.description: True when this incident has been confirmed end-to-end (injects, its detection check flips, resolves) on a fresh cluster. Absent/false means unverified.

platform.description: Platform components that must be installed first (e.g. "ingress" when detection calls the app through the ingress). Not auto-installed.

expectAlert.description: Alertmanager alert this fault should fire. Requires alerts/rule.yaml in the incident directory.

references.description: Links to upstream tool/docs relevant to this incident (kubectl, Prometheus, the failing controller, …).

snippets.description: Applyable manifest snippets that help diagnose or remediate the fault. Template-resolved. Exactly one of 'yaml' or 'path' (relative to the incident directory).
